Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct-Q4_0.gguf: Compact Llama 3.2 1B instruction-tuned model. Quick text generation for short prompts and chat.
Qwen3-0.6B-Q4_0.gguf: Compact Qwen3 0.6B model. Tiny text generation with low memory use.
Qwen3-1.7B-Q4_0.gguf: Qwen3 1.7B instruction-tuned model. Better answer quality for the AI bot, with larger context for the lesson reference.
Qwen3-4B-Q4_K_M.gguf: Mid-size Qwen3 4B model. Drives text prompts in the FLUX.2-klein image pipeline; usable as a chat preset on machines with ~12 GB RAM.
Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M.gguf: Qwen3 8B instruction-tuned model. Best answer quality for the AI bot; needs ~20 GB RAM.
Qwen3.6-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf: Large Qwen3.6 27B multimodal model. 4-bit quantized for lower memory use.
ggml-bci-windowed.bin: Whisper-style decoder for brain-computer interface signals. Reads sliding windows of neural recordings.
abc845adefe27931: BCI signal decoding set. Bundles the windowed decoder with its embedder weights.
ggml-tiny.bin: Whisper tiny speech-to-text model. Quick transcription of short audio clips.
ggml-silero-v5.1.2.bin: Silero V5.1.2 voice activity detector. Detects when someone is speaking into the mic.
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3.q8_0.gguf: Parakeet TDT 0.6B speech-to-text model. Multilingual transcription.
diar_streaming_sortformer_4spk-v2.1.q8_0: Sortformer 4-speaker diarizer. Tags who is speaking in multi-person audio.
parakeet-eou-120m-v1.q8_0.gguf: Parakeet end-of-utterance detector. Marks when a speaker has finished talking.
ac55acec3c2f95f2: English to French translation set. Bundles the EN-FR weights.
585e779c399b8334: English to German translation set. Bundles the EN-DE weights.
chatterbox-s3gen.gguf: Chatterbox speech generator component. Builds audio tokens for the TTS pipeline.
chatterbox-t3-turbo-q8_0.gguf: Chatterbox T3 turbo language model. Drives voice cloning and synthesis.
supertonic-q8_0.gguf: Supertonic multilingual TTS. Reads text aloud across several languages.
supertonic3-q8_0.gguf: Supertonic 3 multilingual TTS. Reads text aloud across several languages.
SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct-Q8_0.gguf: SmolVLM2 500M vision-language model. Reads images and short video frames.
mmproj-SmolVLM2-500M-Video-Instruct-Q8_0: Vision projection weights for SmolVLM2. Connects image features into the language model.
gte-large_fp16.gguf: GTE-large text embedding model. Used for vector search and RAG retrieval.
diffusion_pytorch_model.safetensors: FLUX.2-klein VAE. Companion weights that decode latents into final images.
RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime_6B.pth: Real-ESRGAN x4 upscaler tuned for anime-style images.
wan2.1-i2v-14b-480p-Q4_K_M.gguf: Wan 2.1 image-to-video model. Turns a still image into a short 480p clip.
wan2.1_t2v_1.3B_fp16.safetensors: Wan 2.1 1.3B text-to-video model. Generates short video clips from prompts.
wan_2.1_vae.safetensors: Wan 2.1 VAE. Companion weights for video generation.
umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors: UMT5-XXL text encoder. Translates prompts for the video generation models.
clip_vision_h.safetensors: CLIP vision encoder. Feeds images into the Wan video pipeline.
pi05-base-q-aggressive.gguf: Pi0.5 vision-language-action model. Drives robotic control from camera input.
smolvla-libero-vision-q8.gguf: SmolVLA vision encoder for robotics. Feeds camera frames into the action model.
latin_g2.gguf: Latin-script OCR model. Extracts text from images.
